title: The Two Candles
prompt: Two candles of the same length are lit at the same moment and burn at a steady rate. The thick candle burns out completely after 6 hours; the thin candle burns out after 4 hours. After how many hours is the thick candle exactly twice as long as the thin one?

wrong_feedback.2: At 2 hours the thick candle is 2/3 long and the thin one 1/2 long. Not yet a ratio of two.
wrong_feedback.4: At 4 hours the thin candle is already gone.

reveal_text: The thin candle gutters out. Its smoke bends toward the portraits on the wall and points at the THIRD frame from the left.
